The store is Pine Crossing. I replied to Pree in a thread on her message in #central-team.

- **Where it came from:** Pree posted it in #central-team herself on 9 Jun. The morning receiver at Pine Crossing said the appointment screen only showed the afternoon shift. A driver who arrived at 7:10 had his trailer number written on a sticky note.
- **Follow-up:** Hollis said he'd check the shift template and ask support to reproduce the problem with the store login. Nothing in the channel since then says it was fixed, so I told her to confirm that before marking it resolved on the account sheet.
- **Not to mix up:** Eastbank is a different Marrow store. Its problem is the E1/E2 door labels on ticket PD-4821, not the missing shift.

I only used #central-team and the team's public files, which Pree can see herself.
